body.name: Fully specified rational three-cohort witness \(\mathfrak W_3\)
body.construction: In \(\mathfrak W_3\), set \(\mathcal H=\{4,5,6\}\), \(\mathcal T=\{2,3\}\), \(\mathsf a(h)=3\) for every \(h\in\mathcal H\), \([\underline y,\overline y]=[0,4]\), and hence \(\mathcal E=\mathcal H\times\mathcal T\). The known path \(p^h\) announces at date \(3\), has no implementation before \(h\), and first implements at \(h\); \(p^\infty\) has neither event. Let \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}(G=h)=1/3\) for each \(h\in\mathcal H\), let \(Y_2=2\) almost surely, and let \(Y_3=5/2\) on \(G=4\) and \(Y_3=2\) on \(G\in\{5,6\}\). Set \(\mathcal E_0=\{(4,2),(5,2),(6,2)\}\), set \(\ell_e=u_e=0\) on \(\mathcal E_0\), and set \([\ell_e,u_e]=[-1,1]\) on \(e\in\{(4,3),(5,3),(6,3)\}\). Finally set \(\psi_3=(a_{4,3}+a_{5,3})/2\).
